text:
The physician may be liable because the patient had previously been treated for osteoarthritis of the cervical spine, a relative contraindication to articulatory springing technique in an elderly patient with severe neck pain and limited range of motion. This pre-existing condition increased the risk of injury from cervical manipulation, and the physician should have modified or avoided the technique. Given the provided options, the strongest basis for liability is the prior osteoarthritis treatment.

CONFIDENCE: 70
